mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_portfolio (user_id, file_url, file_name, parsed_text) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{parsedText})
mapper.select: SELECT portfolio_id, user_id, file_url, file_name, parsed_text, created_at, updated_at FROM user_portfolio WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_portfolio WHERE portfolio_id = #{portfolioId} AND user_id = #{userId}
